blind_postseal_rule.document_completeness: Retain every page and every characterization, optimization, unfavorable, absent, unresolved and spectral row in source order.
blind_postseal_rule.pair_selection: Retain every source/product pair explicitly joined by one reported Claisen rearrangement procedure; no yield, selectivity, formula-equality or favorable-result filter is permitted.
blind_postseal_rule.structural_test: Where both source and product structures and formula inscriptions are complete, test identical atom inventory and a positive finite constitutional-incidence change. Never infer an unprinted structure, coproduct or atom map.
blind_postseal_rule.support_test: A conventional structure pair may externally test support incidence but cannot observe the physical identity of individual held supports; that identity remains an independently reconstructed Fold consequence.
blind_postseal_rule.absence: Every pair lacking either complete endpoint remains unresolved; every complete mismatch remains adverse; neither class may be omitted.
blind_postseal_rule.observation_order: The unchanged Fold law, V1 boundary, target identity and value-free exact-pair relation seal before this supplementary PDF opens.

native_arithmetic_boundary: No external numerical zero, signed, decimal, continuum, yield, temperature, time, energy, enantiomeric excess, stereochemical ratio or conventional structure inscription enters native forcing; structural absence is EmptyOne.
